# G1.4 synthetic fixtures

These fixtures exercise deterministic schema, gate, traceability, report, publication, and recovery
mechanics only. They do not contain market Evidence, real user quotes, market data, thesis viability,
decision readiness, or successful external validation. Public identifiers use `.invalid`; imported
user material uses `urn:startup-opportunity:user-provided:`. Higher-tier values are explicitly
synthetic gate scenarios and do not represent real sources.
